name: openai-legacy-compat-closeout
title: Retire explicit OpenAI adapter legacy compat surfaces
description: Close out the remaining explicit OpenAI-compatible legacy adapter entrypoints and re-export facades now that the live runtime defaults to protocol-safe chat/stream orchestration.
creator: yudi
notes: 2026-04-21 full-repo audit confirmed that the live OpenAI adapter public entrypoints already routed through protocol-safe chat/stream methods, but the package still exposed explicit legacy compat entrypoints and compatibility re-export modules under openai_compatible.compat/**. 2026-04-21 closeout completed: deleted the public legacy compat entrypoints and dead facade modules, removed package-level compat re-export seams, and kept only internal low-level fallback helpers behind protocol-safe entrypoints. Verified with `ruff check backend/app/ai/adapters/openai_adapter.py backend/app/ai/adapters/openai_compatible backend/tests/ai/adapters/test_openai_adapter_protocol_entrypoints.py backend/tests/test_openai_adapter_responses.py` and `pytest backend/tests/ai/adapters/test_openai_adapter_protocol_entrypoints.py backend/tests/test_openai_adapter_responses.py`.
